method: Same-agent English/Marathi close reading, formula-by-formula comparison, reverse paraphrase and documented source-correction projection. No independent human or native-speaker review is claimed.
scope: Composition of many-place functions, projection functions, ignored/repeated/reordered arguments, and elimination of apparent arity restrictions.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Unary composition h(x)=f(g(x)) generalizes by feeding the n-place values g_0(x),...,g_(k-1)(x) into the k-place f. If all components are computable, so is the resulting n-place h.
samples.checks: The roles of k and n remain distinct. Under OLCMP-002 the explanatory h-input tuple ends at x_(n-1), while f's computed input tuple still ends at y_(k-1).

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Projection functions select coordinates. They let a composition ignore x and y so that Succ applied to the third projection returns the successor of z.
samples.checks: The projection indices, the roles of f and g_0, k=1 and the resulting arity 3 are preserved.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Projections can duplicate one input to define h(x)=Add(x,x), or reorder two inputs to define h(x_0,x_1)=f(x_1,x_0).
samples.checks: Both repeated projection 0 and the reversed projection order 1,0 are preserved exactly.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Projection functions also make component functions with apparently different arities fit one common n-place composition. The displayed two-variable h is decomposed into f composed with projection 0, an auxiliary l, and projection 1; l itself is g composed with projections 0,0,1.
samples.checks: All repeated variables, projection indices, nesting and the definitions of h and l are unchanged.

source_observations: OLCMP-002 documents and corrects the frozen source's x_(k-1) output-argument bound where the declared n-place function h requires x_(n-1).
T053 supplies the established संयोजन term; T207 supplies n-स्थानी and स्थानसंख्या.
T253 supports the edition's प्रक्षेपण term, while every displayed selector equation controls its coordinate meaning here.
T051 supports the identification of the one-place projection with the identity function एकरूपता फलन.
limitations: No independent human or native-speaker review has been performed.
The source correction is a same-agent mathematical defect determination recorded in the durable issue ledger and replayed through a unit-specific QA projection.
